subject.title: message-tool send mid-turn writes 'delivery-mirror' side-branch into transcript → permanent HTTP 400 loop, session silently dead

question: Should this mixed report remain the coordination issue for both delivery-mirror side-branch poisoning and empty signed Anthropic thinking replay poisoning, or should maintainers split it across the narrower existing Anthropic and delivery-mirror paths?
rationale: The remaining work spans separate but interacting transcript-replay paths with overlapping open and merged PRs, and choosing the canonical tracking/fix shape is a maintainer coordination decision rather than a safe new repair job.

options.title: Coordinate Existing Cluster
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the Anthropic replay PR and decide whether the delivery-mirror side-branch half still needs a focused fixture or follow-up.

options.title: Split Tracking
options.body: Move the Anthropic thinking follow-up to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92201 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 and keep this issue focused only on delivery-mirror side branches.

options.title: Wait For Reporter Fixture
options.body: Ask for sanitized JSONL/log excerpts before deciding whether the delivery-mirror half still reproduces on current main.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Existing Cluster
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the Anthropic replay PR and decide whether the delivery-mirror side-branch half still needs a focused fixture or follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the listed project owner and the best current routing candidate for coordinating multiple active session/provider replay fixes.
